        priceLabel: '$20.00',
        image: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
        description: 'Tejido compresivo suave (77% nylon, 23% elastano) disponible en tirantes y manga larga para estilizar cintura y abdomen.'
      },
      {
        id: 'body-xl',
        name: 'Body Moldeador Torso (Tallas XL, XXXL, 4XL)',
        category: 'bodys',
        badge: 'Tallas reales hoy',
        price: 18.00,
        priceLabel: '$18.00',
        image: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
        description: 'Stock real en tallas grandes (tirantes y manga larga) con entrega inmediata en Caracas, sin esperar encargos.'
      },
      {
        id: 'pack-bodys',
        name: 'Pack 2x Bodys Tallas Grandes (XL–4XL)',
        category: 'bodys',
        badge: 'Ahorra $6',
        price: 30.00,
        priceLabel: '$30.00',
        image: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
        description: 'Llévate 2 bodys moldeadores Torso (combinables entre tirantes y manga larga) en tallas XL, XXXL o 4XL por $15 c/u.'
      },
      {
        id: 'kit-emprendedor',
        name: 'Kit Emprendedor Fajas Torso',
        category: 'mayor',
        badge: 'Mayorista',
        price: 99.99,
        priceLabel: '$99.99',
        image: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
        description: 'Surtido mayorista de bodys moldeadores Torso empacados listos para revender en toda Venezuela.'
      },
      {
        id: 'bolsas-eco',
        name: 'Bolsas Ecológicas por Paquete (Mayor y Detal)',
        category: 'mayor',
        badge: 'Por paquete',
        price: 0,
        priceLabel: 'Cotizar paquete',
        image: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,',
        description: '5 modelos sin estampado: Mini Eco (30x25cm), Standard Plus (35x25cm), Horizontal Mediano (30x10x40cm), Gran Capacidad (41x12x35cm) y Maxi Blanca (50x50cm).'
      }
    ];

    let activeCategory = 'all';
    let searchQuery = '';
    const cart = {};

    const productGrid = document.getElementById('productGrid');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const cartCountBadge = document.getElementById('cartCountBadge');
    const cartItemsContainer = document.getElementById('cartItemsContainer');
    const cartTotalEl = document.getElementById('cartTotal');
    const quoteNote = document.getElementById('quoteNote');
    const whatsappCheckoutBtn = document.getElementById('whatsappCheckoutBtn');
    const cartDrawer = document.getElementById('cartDrawer');
    const cartOverlay = document.getElementById('cartOverlay');
    const toastEl = document.getElementById('toast');

    function showToast(msg) {
      toastEl.textContent = msg;
      toastEl.classList.remove('opacity-0');
      setTimeout(() => toastEl.classList.add('opacity-0'), 2200);
    }

    function renderProducts() {
      const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
      const filtered = PRODUCTS.filter(p => {
        const matchCat = activeCategory === 'all' || p.category === activeCategory;
        const matchText = !q || p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.badge.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        return matchCat && matchText;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        productGrid.innerHTML = '';
        emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
      }

      emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
      productGrid.innerHTML = filtered.map(p => `
        <article class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#DCECCB] overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition">
          <div>
            <div class="relative aspect-[4/3] bg-[#F3FCE7] overflow-hidden">
              <img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.name}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" />
              <span class="absolute top-3 left-3 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#DCF7B8] text-[#0E4D2B] text-[11px] font-extrabold shadow-sm">${p.badge}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="p-4">
              <h3 class="font-bold text-base text-[#0D2316] leading-snug">${p.name}</h3>
              <p class="text-xs text-[#45614F] mt-1.5 line-clamp-2">${p.description}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="px-4 pb-4 pt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span class="text-lg font-extrabold text-[#0E4D2B]">${p.priceLabel}</span>
            <button type="button" data-add-id="${p.id}" class="add-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#0E4D2B] hover:bg-[#09361E] text-white text-xs font-semibold transition">
              + Agregar
            </button>
          </div>
        </article>
      `).join('');

      document.querySelectorAll('.add-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => addToCart(btn.getAttribute('data-add-id')));
      });
    }

    function addToCart(id) {
      const product = PRODUCTS.find(p => p.id === id);
      if (!product) return;
      cart[id] = (cart[id] || 0) + 1;
      renderCart();
      showToast('Agregado: ' + product.name);
    }

    function changeQty(id, delta) {
      if (!cart[id]) return;
      cart[id] += delta;
      if (cart[id] <= 0) delete cart[id];
      renderCart();
    }

    function buildOrderText() {
      const entries = Object.entries(cart);
      if (entries.length === 0) return 'Hola ShoppingConLanda, quiero información sobre su catálogo.';
      let total = 0;
      let hasQuote = false;
      const lines = ['Hola ShoppingConLanda, quiero hacer este pedido:'];
      entries.forEach(([id, qty]) => {
        const p = PRODUCTS.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (!p) return;
        if (p.price > 0) {
          total += p.price * qty;
          lines.push(`- ${qty}x ${p.name} ($${(p.price * qty).toFixed(2)})`);
        } else {
          hasQuote = true;
          lines.push(`- ${qty}x ${p.name} (Solicitar cotización de paquete)`);
        }
      });
      lines.push(`Total estimado: $${total.toFixed(2)}` + (hasQuote ? ' + artículos por cotizar' : ''));
      lines.push('Zona de entrega / envío:');
      return lines.join('\n');
    }

    function renderCart() {
      const entries = Object.entries(cart);
      const totalCount = entries.reduce((sum, [, qty]) => sum + qty, 0);
      cartCountBadge.textContent = totalCount;

      if (entries.length === 0) {
        cartItemsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-12 text-[#45614F] text-sm">Aún no has agregado productos. Elige tus favoritos del catálogo.</div>';
        cartTotalEl.textContent = '$0.00';
        quoteNote.classList.add('hidden');
        whatsappCheckoutBtn.href = 'https://wa.me/584140893369?text=' + encodeURIComponent(buildOrderText());
        return;
      }

      let total = 0;
      let hasQuote = false;

      cartItemsContainer.innerHTML = entries.map(([id, qty]) => {
        const p = PRODUCTS.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (!p) return '';
        if (p.price > 0) total += p.price * qty;
        else hasQuote = true;

        return `
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-[#DCECCB] bg-white">
            <div class="min-w-0">
              <div class="font-semibold text-sm text-[#0D2316] truncate">${p.name}</div>
              <div class="text-xs text-[#45614F]">${p.price > 0 ? '$' + (p.price * qty).toFixed(2) : 'Cotizar paquete'}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
              <button type="button" data-qty-id="${id}" data-delta="-1" class="qty-btn w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-[#F3FCE7] hover:bg-[#DCF7B8] text-[#0E4D2B] font-bold text-sm">-</button>
              <span class="w-6 text-center text-sm font-semibold">${qty}</span>
              <button type="button" data-qty-id="${id}" data-delta="1" class="qty-btn w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-[#F3FCE7] hover:bg-[#DCF7B8] text-[#0E4D2B] font-bold text-sm">+</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');

      document.querySelectorAll('.qty-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          changeQty(btn.getAttribute('data-qty-id'), parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-delta'), 10));
        });
      });

      cartTotalEl.textContent = '$' + total.toFixed(2);
      if (hasQuote) quoteNote.classList.remove('hidden');
      else quoteNote.classList.add('hidden');

      whatsappCheckoutBtn.href = 'https://wa.me/584140893369?text=' + encodeURIComponent(buildOrderText());
    }

    function openCart() {
      cartOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
      cartDrawer.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
    }

    function closeCart() {
      cartOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
      cartDrawer.classList.add('translate-x-full');
    }

    document.getElementById('openCartBtn').addEventListener('click', openCart);
    document.getElementById('closeCartBtn').addEventListener('click', closeCart);
    cartOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeCart);

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-quick-add]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        addToCart(btn.getAttribute('data-quick-add'));
        openCart();
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        activeCategory = btn.getAttribute('data-category');
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.className = 'filter-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-white border border-[#C6E3A6] text-[#0E4D2B] hover:bg-[#F3FCE7] transition';
        });
        btn.className = 'filter-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold bg-[#0E4D2B] text-white transition';
        renderProducts();
      });
    });

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      searchQuery = e.target.value;
      renderProducts();
    });

    document.getElementById('copyOrderBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const text = buildOrderText();
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => showToast('Resumen copiado')).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text));
      } else {
        fallbackCopy(text);
      }
    });

    function fallbackCopy(text) {
      const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = text;
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      try {
        document.execCommand('copy');
        showToast('Resumen copiado');
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('No se pudo copiar automáticamente');
      }
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-toggle').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const content = btn.nextElementSibling;
        const icon = btn.querySelector('.faq-icon');
        const isHidden = content.classList.contains('hidden');
        content.classList.toggle('hidden');
        icon.textContent = isHidden ? '−' : '+';
      });
    });

    renderProducts();
    renderCart();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
